name: plcsim_connect
description: Connect to a running Siemens S7-PLCSIM Advanced instance by name (default 'PLC_1'). S7-PLCSIM Advanced V8.0+ only (S7-1500 / ET 200SP); standard S7-PLCSIM and S7-1200 simulation are not supported. A failure message explains why (missing API, runtime not running, standard S7-PLCSIM detected).

instance_name.description: Instance name of the virtual controller (e.g. 'PLC_1'). Default is 'PLC_1'.
